transcript.text: Hello and welcome back.

In this final part of our on Print shop version 12.2 feature tutorial, we'll walk you through the powerful integrations and AI enhancements that make your workflow smarter, your data more reliable, and your customer experience smoother.
Let's begin with one of the most exciting updates, our strength and integration with Four Over.
A dedicated interface transfer OPS order to four over available on the four over orders transfer page now makes it faster and easier to map on print shop products.
With four over products.
The admin can utilize this button or from the list order section the transfer the OPS order to four over action.
Enter the order ID and then follow the on screen steps to transfer the OPS product orders to four over.
This reduces manual effort and ensures seamless order processing between the two systems.
Admins can access and use the Visual Price Calculator directly to enhance admin usability while viewing for Over products.
To enable this feature, go to Store Configuration, click on Site Settings and under the Product tab in the Admin panel, locate the Enable Visual Price Calculator for Admin Users option.
Turn it on and click Save to apply the changes.
Next, go to the Products section and select For Over Products.
On a particular product, click the Action button, choose OPS Product, then click Edit Product.
Now navigate to the Settings tab.
Here you'll find a toggle name, Display Visual Price Calculator.
Turn it on and click Save to apply your changes.
Once enabled, admins can conveniently use the Visual Price Calculator while managing products, ensuring quicker and more accurate pricing adjustments.
Further, the Product Personalization feature allows admins to customize option labels and attributes to ensure clear, accurate, consistent product information across the storefront.
The Option Labels interface allows admins to modify the storefront option name and attribute name content when the page loads.
All option labels are displayed by default and admins can search for specific options or select an option to change its language.
The list includes several key details.
Option Name, which displays the name of the option.
Attribute Name, which lists the corresponding for over attribute names for that option.
Text Line, which shows the text to be displayed on the front end.

Default, which lets the admin set a default label to be shown for all products using that option, and Action, which allows the admin to save changes, view the list of categories in which the label is used, or navigate directly to a specific product category.
Admins can personalize option labels at 3 levels, Product, Category, and Global.
At the product level, admins can define unique and accurate labels for each product.
To do this, go to Products, select for over Products and click the Action button.
Choose OPS Product, then select Edit Product and go to the Settings tab.
Next, open the Product Wise Label Personalization tab and add or edit labels as needed.
At the category level, click on for Over Products, then go to Product Settings and select Option Label Personalization.
Once set, all products in that category will automatically inherit the same labels.
This helps maintain consistency across similar product types while allowing individual customization flexibility.
If no product level or category level labels are defined, the system will automatically fall back to the default for Over option labels, ensuring that appropriate labeling is always displayed.
To improve the design experience for Over, Help templates are now imported and synced automatically along with the For Over Products import.
Once the templates are imported, they will be displayed in the Help Template tab of the respective product details.
This means customers get instant design guidance exactly when they need it, ensuring accuracy and reducing mistakes during customization.
We've also simplified the checkout for non print products on the storefront.

When the customer selects the non print option for the colour spec option, they will have the option to add the product directly to the cart and the upload step will be skipped entirely, making the purchase journey more convenient.
And for products such as event tickets requiring sequential numbering, we've added an option to upload a CSV file directly in the price calculator.
This ensures accurate data input for variable numbering jobs, saving time and improving order accuracy.
Next, let's look at analytics and tracking improvements.
We've implemented server side purchase event tracking for GA 4.
This means purchase data is captured accurately even if customers don't return to your site after completing a payment through redirection based gateways.
In addition, support for the Facebook Conversions API has been added.
This helps improve campaign performance tracking and gives you more reliable insights into how your ads are driving sales moving forward.
We've made login security and testing more seamless.
Admins can now test capture settings before saving them.
This prevents misconfigurations that could cause login issues, ensuring a smooth and secure experience for both admins and storefront users.
Finally, let's talk about AI.
We've upgraded our integration with Google Gemini AI and a generative AI settings by supporting the Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Gemini 2.5 Pro models.
This enhancement improves the quality of automatically generated content, such as product descriptions and personalized customer messages.
The output feels more natural, engaging, and tailored to customer needs, helping you deliver better communication with less effort.
And that wraps up Part 3 of the On Print Shop Version 12.2 tutorial series.

With these integrations and AI enhancements, your store not only becomes more efficient but also more intelligent, streamlining operations, strengthening customer trust, and giving you better insights for growth.
Thank you for watching this tutorial series on On Print Shop Version 12.2.
If you have any questions, our support team is ready to help.
You can reach us via live chat or e-mail us at support at on printshop.com.
